title: ruMeme Descriptions
author: foldl
retrieval_method: Hugging Face datasets-server rows API; images stored locally without content modification
notes: Russian-language meme images and dataset descriptions. Topic categories are derived locally from description keywords. Memes whose images contain English text are kept in a separate English memes filter. The top-text layout filters use a strict metadata rule plus OCR coordinates: any reliably recognized text below the upper 30 percent of the image excludes the meme. The remaining shortlist was visually reviewed.
